chapters.title: Introduction
chapters.sourcePressure: Sets the book's standard: management advice is tested after plans fail, information is partial, morale is fragile, and no option is painless.
chapters.coreMove: Recognize the struggle as a leadership operating condition and keep responsibility with the decision maker.
chapters.commonMisread: A generic resilience introduction about staying positive when work is difficult.

chapters.title: From Communist to Venture Capitalist
chapters.sourcePressure: Uses biography as formation evidence for how Horowitz reads power, incentives, systems, technical constraints, and founder responsibility.
chapters.coreMove: Use origin stories as diagnostic context without letting them become proof.
chapters.commonMisread: A simple career biography that celebrates contradictions as colorful backstory.

chapters.title: I Will Survive
chapters.sourcePressure: Follows Loudcloud-style collapse pressure where survival replaces growth optics and the leader must buy runway, communicate truth, execute, and reassess.
chapters.coreMove: Reset success to disciplined continuation when the market invalidates the old plan.
chapters.commonMisread: A perseverance lesson about never giving up.

chapters.title: This Time with Feeling
chapters.sourcePressure: Shows that a second hard cycle arrives before recovery is complete, so leaders need decision hygiene under recurring strain.
chapters.coreMove: Turn repeated emotional load into explicit decision hygiene before fatigue distorts the call.
chapters.commonMisread: A chapter about being more emotionally expressive or more stoic.

chapters.title: When Things Fall Apart
chapters.sourcePressure: Moves from private CEO burden to direct crisis action: tell the truth, make painful people decisions, avoid rescue fantasies, and reduce total harm from delay.
chapters.coreMove: Convert private pressure into clear facts, clean people calls, and controlled execution.
chapters.commonMisread: A toughness chapter about pushing through chaos.

chapters.title: Take Care of the People, the Products, and the Profits, In That Order
chapters.sourcePressure: Defines the causal chain from people systems to product reliability to durable profit, with training and accountability as forms of care.
chapters.coreMove: Trace financial and product weakness back to the people system before treating profit as a separate target.
chapters.commonMisread: A nice-place-to-work lesson that puts morale above standards.

chapters.title: Concerning the Going Concern
chapters.sourcePressure: Scaling exposes founder-led informality as coordination debt; leaders must build mission-linked process, stage-fit executives, and behavior loops.
chapters.coreMove: Replace inherited informality with operating architecture that clarifies ownership and cadence.
chapters.commonMisread: A generic scaling chapter about adding more process.

chapters.title: How to Lead Even When You Don't Know Where You Are Going
chapters.sourcePressure: Ambiguity is normal; leader psychology, accurate boundaries, and a known-unknown-next-move message keep teams functional without fake certainty.
chapters.coreMove: Give directional clarity while naming uncertainty accurately and assigning the next move.
chapters.commonMisread: A confidence chapter about sounding calm.

chapters.title: First Rule of Entrepreneurship: There Are No Rules
chapters.sourcePressure: Rejects universal formulas while preserving principles; acquisition pressure and changing facts require live judgment about timing, leverage, trust, and consequence.
chapters.coreMove: Keep judgment alive by testing whether a rule fits the present facts before applying it.
chapters.commonMisread: A permission slip to ignore standards or improvise everything.

chapters.title: The End of the Beginning
chapters.sourcePressure: Separates the outcome of a sale or transition from the interpretation of the hard years, asking which principles travel and which tactics should stop.
chapters.coreMove: Audit a successful transition so the hard years become durable judgment rather than a clean victory story.
chapters.commonMisread: A celebratory ending about winning after struggle.
